title: [WT-08T] Tests: held-out acceptance cases for worktree completion landing
definitionOfDone: scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh and scripts/tests/worktree-landing.ps1 exist; `--list` prints at least 12 cases, each tagged local or remote, with the same case names in both files.
Every case named in the description is present and asserts on git state (refs, reflog, parents, file bytes), not only on log text.
Against current code `bash scripts/tests/worktree-landing.sh` exits non-zero with every case failing on its assertion (no harness crash); `--only local` and `--only remote` select the tagged subsets.

The ps1 twin parses (powershell -NoProfile -Command "$null = [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile('scripts/tests/worktree-landing.ps1',[ref]$null,[ref]$e); if ($e) { exit 1 }") and is red the same way on a Windows seat.
No file outside scripts/tests/worktree-landing.{sh,ps1} is modified; the verification command exits 0.
